40017918.author: पदार्थः
40017918.content: अथ and then, रावणानुजः Ravana's brother, तस्याम् them, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana अवस्थायाम् tendered, परेषाम् for enemies, अहितम् not good, अर्थसाधकम् to accomplish the task, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke

40017918.author: Translation
40017918.content: Ravana's brother seeing Lakshmana spoke these words of advice to accomplish the task and which is not good for the enemies.

40017919.author: पदार्थः
40017919.content: मेघश्यामम् dark as cloud, यत् that which, एतत् all that, राक्षसानीकम् army of Rakshasas, विलोक्यते be engaged, एतत् all this, पादपायुधैः trees as weapons, कपिभिः monkeys too, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अयोध्यताम् will get engaged

40017919.author: Translation
40017919.content: "The army of Rakshasas looks like a dark cloud and let the monkeys too get engaged to fight swiftly with trees as weapons."

40017920.author: पदार्थः
40017920.content: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, महतः mighty, अस्यअनीकस्य army of Rakshasas, भेदने shatter, यत that which, अत्र there, भिन्ने broken, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतोऽपि the son of Rakshasa king, दृश्यःभविष्यति will become visible

40017920.author: Translation
40017920.content: "O Lakshmana! Shatter this mighty army of Rakshasas. When it is broken Ravana's son will become visible."

40017921.author: पदार्थः
40017921.content: सः he, त्वम् by you, इन्द्राशनिप्रख्यैः like Indra's thunderbolt, शरैः arrows, परान् at enemy, अवकिरन् use, एतत् by that, कर्म action, यावत् all, न समाप्यते not completed, आशु quickly, अभिद्रववै not attack

40017921.author: Translation
40017921.content: "You have come to attack the enemy. Before he completes his action quickly attack him with the thunderbolt of Indra."

40017922.author: पदार्थः
40017922.content: वीर heroic, दुरात्मानम् of wicked mind, मायापरम् conjurer, अधार्मिकम् unrighteous, क्रूरकर्माणम् of cruel deeds, सर्वलोकभयावहम् terror for all the worlds, रावणइम् Ravana's son, जहि destroy

40017922.author: Translation
40017922.content: "Hero, wicked minded, conjurer, unrighteous and cruel one who is a terror for all worlds is Ravana's son. Destroy him."

40017923.author: पदार्थः
40017923.content: शुभलक्षणः auspicious, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतं Rakshasa king's son प्रति in turn, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष rained

40017923.author: Translation
40017923.content: Lakshmana, who had auspicious marks, on hearing Vibheeshana rained showers of arrows on Ravana's son.

40017924.author: पदार्थः
40017924.content: द्रुमद्रिनखयोधिन: trees, mountains, nails,, ऋक्षाः Bears, शाखामृगाश्चैव monkeys too, सहिताः together, अवस्थितम् drawn, तत् अनीकम् that army, अभ्यधावन्त initiated

40017924.author: Translation
40017924.content: The Bears and monkeys together initiated a fight with the army with trees, mountains, and nails as weapons.

40017925.author: पदार्थः
40017925.content: राक्षसाः च Rakshasas also, समरे in battle, कपिसैन्यजिघांसवः to kill monkey army, शितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, असिभिः swords, शक्तितोमरैः javelins and lances, उद्यतै: launched, अभ्यवर्तन्त attacked

40017925.author: Translation
40017925.content: The Rakshasas also launched attacks in the battle with sharp swords, javelins, and lances.

40017926.author: पदार्थः
40017926.content: कपिरक्षसाम् monkeys and Rakshasas, महता mighty, शब्देन sounds, लङ्काम् Lanka, समन्ततः all over, नादयन्वै resounded, सः that, तुमुलः intense, सम्प्रहारः mutual striking, सञ्जज्ञे equipped with

40017926.author: Translation
40017926.content: With both the monkeys and Rakshasas mutually striking intensely, the mighty sounds resounded all over Lanka

40017927.author: पदार्थः
40017927.content: विविधाकारैः various shapes, शस्त्रः weapons, शितैः sharp, बाणैश्च arrows also, पादपैः trees, उद्यतैः thrown, घोरैः dreadful, गिरिशृङ्गैश्च mountain peaks, आकाशम् sky, आवृतम् covered

40017927.author: Translation
40017927.content: The sky was covered with weapons of various shapes, arrows, trees, mountain peaks thrown at each other and were dreadful.

40017928.author: पदार्थः
40017928.content: विकृताननबाहवः misshapen faces and arms, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, वानरेषु at monkeys, शस्त्राणि weapons, निवेशयन्तः pierced in their bodies, ते in them, सुमहत् great, भयम् fear, चक्रुः created

40017928.author: Translation
40017928.content: The Rakshasas with disfigured faces and arms, attacked the Vanaras, and their bodies pierced with weapons created great fear in them.

40017929.author: पदार्थः
40017929.content: तथैव by that, वानराश्च Vanaras, सकलैः all, वृक्षैः trees, गिरिशृङ्गैः mountain peaks, समरे in the battle, राक्षसर्षभान् bulls among Rakshasas, अभिजघ्नुः wounded, निजघ्नुः च and assailed

40017929.author: Translation
40017929.content: The monkeys likewise wounded and assailed the bulls among Rakshasas with trees and mountain peaks in the battle.

40017930.author: पदार्थः
40017930.content: महाकायैः of huge body, महाबलैः mighty, ऋक्षवानरमुख्यैः Bears and Vanara leaders, युध्यमानानाम् fighting in war, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, महत् great, भयम् fear, अजायत caused

40017930.author: Translation
40017930.content: Mighty Bears and Vanaras of huge body, fighting in the battle caused great fear in Rakshasas.

40017931.author: पदार्थः
40017931.content: दुर्धर्षः one who is difficult to overpower, सः he, शत्रुभिः enemies, अर्धितम् crying in vain, स्वम् own, अनीकम् army, विषण्णम् agony, श्रुत्वा hearing, कर्मणि action, अननुष्ठिते not completed, उदतिष्ठत got up

40017931.author: Translation
40017931.content: Indrajith, who is difficult to overpower, on hearing the cries of his own army in agony got up without completing the task (of ritual).

40017932.author: पदार्थः
40017932.content: जातक्रोधः enraged, सः he, रावणिः Indrajith, वृक्षान्धकारात् darkness of trees, निर्गम्य coming out, पूर्वयुक्तम् already yoked, सुसंयुतम् firmly fixed, सज्जम् ready, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended

40017932.author: Translation
40017932.content: Enraged, Indrajith coming out of the darkness of trees ascended the chariot already yoked and fixed firmly.

40017933.author: पदार्थः
40017933.content: भीमकार्मुकशरः armed with terrific bow and arrows, कालमेघसमप्रभ: body shining like a rainy cloud, रक्तास्यनयनः with red eyes, कृद्ध: angry, सः he, अन्तकः like spirit of death, मृत्युरिव like death, बभौ seemed

40017933.author: Translation
40017933.content: Indrajith, armed with a terrific bow and arrows, his body shining like a rainy cloud, with red eyes, angry face, seemed like the spirit of death.

40017934.author: पदार्थः
40017934.content: रथस्थम् from the chariot, तम् him, दृष्टवैव seeing, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, युयुत्सताम् prepared for war, भीमवेगानाम् endowed with terrific speed, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तत् बलम् his army, पर्यवर्तत surrounded

40017934.author: Translation
40017934.content: Seeing Lakshmana prepared for war, the Rakshasa army endowed with speed surrounded him.

40017935.author: पदार्थः
40017935.content: तस्मिन् काले in the meantime, धरणीधरसङ्काशः who resembled mountain, अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुदुरासदम् difficult to overpower, महावृक्षम् huge tree, उद्यम्य taking up, राक्षसानाम् at Rakshasas, तत् those, सैन्यम् army, कालाग्निरिव like fire at dissolution, निर्दहन् created havoc, सःhe, वानरःVanara, युधि in combat, बहुभिः many, वृक्षैः trees, निःसज्ञम् fighting, चकार went about

40017935.author: Translation
40017935.content: In the meantime, Hanuman, who resembled a mountain, a tamer of enemies, who is difficult to overpower, taking up huge trees fighting with Rakshasas created havoc like fire at the time of dissolution and went about.

40017936.author: पदार्थः
40017936.content: तस्मिन् काले in the meantime, धरणीधरसङ्काशः who resembled mountain, अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुदुरासदम् difficult to overpower, महावृक्षम् huge tree, उद्यम्य taking up, राक्षसानाम् at Rakshasas, तत् those, सैन्यम् army, कालाग्निरिव like fire at dissolution, निर्दहन् created havoc, सःhe, वानरःVanara, युधि in combat, बहुभिः many, वृक्षैः trees, निःसज्ञम् fighting, चकार went about

40017936.author: Translation
40017936.content: In the meantime, Hanuman, who resembled a mountain, a tamer of enemies, who is difficult to overpower, taking up huge trees fighting with Rakshasas created havoc like fire at the time of dissolution and went about.

40017937.author: पदार्थः
40017937.content: राक्षसानाम् at Rakshasas, सहस्राणि thousands, तरसा at great speed, विध्वंसयन्तम् destroying, पवनात्मजम् WindGod's son, दृष्टवैव seeing, अवाकिरन् surrounded

40017937.author: Translation
40017937.content: Seeing the wind god's son destroying, thousands of Rakshasas got together surrounding him.

40017938.author: पदार्थः
40017938.content: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place

40017938.author: Translation
40017938.content: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.

40017939.author: पदार्थः
40017939.content: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place

40017939.author: Translation
40017939.content: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.

40017940.author: पदार्थः
40017940.content: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place

40017940.author: Translation
40017940.content: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.

40017941.author: पदार्थः
40017941.content: शितशूलधराः holding sharp trident, शूलैः trident, असिपाणयः swords in hand, असिभिः च swords, शक्तिहस्ताः javelins in hand, शक्तीभिः च javelins, पट्टिशायुधाः armed with spears, पट्टिशैः spears, शुभदर्शनैः bright looking, कुन्तै: च glowing, शतशः iron bars, शतघ्नीभिः like fire, आयसैः iron, मुद्गरैरपि axes also, घोरैः dreadful, परशुभिश्चैव hammers, भिदनिपालैश्च Bhindi Palas, वज्रकल्पैः like thunderbolt, मुष्टिभिः fists, अशनिसन्निभैः like lightning, तलैः descended, पर्वतोपमम् like mountain, समन्तात् all over, समासाद्य collected, अभिजघ्नुः skilful, सङ्ग्रुद्धः furious, तेषाम् them, महत् huge, कदनम् war, चकार took place

40017941.author: Translation
40017941.content: Between the skilful Rakshasas armed with sharp tridents, swords, javelins in hand, with spears in hand, bright iron bars glowing like fire, with iron axes, dreadful hammers, Bhindi palas and Hanuman, with thunderbolt like fists that descended like lightning, and slaps which descended like mountains, a huge skillful war took place.

40017942.author: पदार्थः
40017942.content: सःइन्द्रजित् that Indrajith, कपिश्रेष्ठम् foremost of monkeys, अचलोपमम् like mountain, असन्त्रस्तम् without weapon, अमित्रान् enemies, सूदमानम् fearless, पवनात्मजम् Hanuman, ददर्श witnessed

40017942.author: Translation
40017942.content: Indrajith witnessed Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras without weapons, fearlessly fighting.

40017943.author: पदार्थः
40017943.content: सः he, सारथिम् charioteer, इदम् thus, उवाचspoke, एषःin that way, वानरःVanara, यत्र there, याहि if not, उपेक्षितःkeep waiting, नः not, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, क्षयम् reduced, कुर्यादेवहि no doubt destroy

40017943.author: Translation
40017943.content: Thus Indrajith spoke to the charioteer "This Vanara will no doubt reduce the Rakshasa army if we keep waiting."

40017944.author: पदार्थः
40017944.content: तेन therefore, इति this way, उक्तः spoke, सारथिः charioteer, रथे chariot, स्थितम् seated, परमदुर्धर्षम् highly difficult to encounter, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, वहन् to that place, मारुतिःMaruthi, यत्र there, ययौ went

40017944.author: Translation
40017944.content: On hearing Indrajith who is highly difficult to encounter speaking in that way his charioteer drove Indrajith, to that place, where Maruthi was.

40017945.author: पदार्थः
40017945.content: दुर्धर्षःdreadful, सःराक्षसः that Rakshasa, अभ्युपेत्य going near, कपिमूर्थनि face of monkey, शरान् arrows, खङ्गान् swords, पट्टसासिपरश्वधान् iron bars, spears, अभ्यवर्षत rained

40017945.author: Translation
40017945.content: Going near Hanuman, that dreadful Rakshasa, rained arrows, spears, swords and iron bars on the face of Hanuman.

40017946.author: पदार्थः
40017946.content: सःमारुतिः he, Maruthi, घोराणि frightening, तानिशस्त्राणि those weapons, प्रतिगृह्य receiving, महता great, रोषेण rage, आविष्टः overcome by, इदंवाक्यम् this words, उवाच spoke

40017946.author: Translation
40017946.content: Receiving those frightening weapons, Maruthi spoke these words overcome by anger.

40017947.author: पदार्थः
40017947.content: दुर्मते evil minded, रावणात्मज Indrajith, शूरः warrior, असियदि such, युध्यस्व fight, वायुपुत्रम् son of WindGod, समासाद्य having met, जीवन् life, न प्रतियास्यसि not return alive

40017947.author: Translation
40017947.content: "Evil minded hero! Fight with me back having met, you shall not return alive."

40017948.author: पदार्थः
40017948.content: दुर्बुद्धे cruel, मे with me, द्वन्द्वम् duel, यदि if you like, बाहुभ्याम् arms, सम्प्रयुध्यस्व in duel war, आहवे come, वेगम् quickly, सहस्व with stand, ततः then, त्वम् you, रक्षसाम् among Rakshasas, वरःforemost

40017948.author: Translation
40017948.content: "Fight with me for a duel war if you like. Come quickly and with stand, then you will become foremost among Rakshasas.

40017949.author: पदार्थः
40017949.content: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समुद्यतशरासनम् having seated, रावणात्मजम् Indrajith, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, जिघांसन्तम् is ready to attack, लक्ष्मणाय Lakshmana, आचष्टे told

40017949.author: Translation
40017949.content: "Vibheeshana told Lakshmana that Indarjith having seated is ready to attack Hanuman."

40017950.author: पदार्थः
40017950.content: वासवनिर्जेता conqueror of Indra, सः he, यः that, रावणस्यआत्मसम्भवः Ravana's son, सःएषः in that way, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय reaching, हनूमन्तम् at Hanuman, जिघांसति seeks to kill

40017950.author: Translation
40017950.content: "Ravana's son, the conqueror of Indra, having taken a se at in the chariot seeks to kill Hanuman."

40017951.author: पदार्थः
40017951.content: सौमित्रे Saumithri, अप्रतिमसंस्थानैः of incomparable craftsmanship, शत्रुनिवारणैः formidable weapons, जीवितान्तकरैः capable of killing enemies, घोरैः dreadful, शरैः arrows, तम् them, रावणिम् Ravana's son, जहि kill him

40017951.author: Translation
40017951.content: "O Saumithri! Kill that son of Ravana with your formidable weapons of incomparable craftsmanship, dreadful arrows capable of killing enemies."
